title: Choose the bolder Helios world
question: This hand eliminates every previous direction. Split-Flap Operations Board is my recommendation: it beats the dealt leader on both operator recognition and lifecycle clarity while remaining genuinely ownable.

options.label: Causal Tension Field
options.lineage: tensegrity structures, force diagrams, and counterbalanced loads
options.thesis: Every signal, order, position, and limit is held in balance by visible forces and counterforces.
options.viewport: A dark causal force network occupies the operating field; source, hypothesis, signal, risk, order, fill, and position nodes are joined by tension paths while conventional ledgers remain docked at the edges.
options.case: Excellent causal truth and risk visualization, but the network demands more interpretation than the split-flap board for ordinary order work.
options.risk: Beautiful geometry can obscure simple state unless every line is queryable and every entity retains a ledger representation.

raised.raise: Every node and force path uses exact registration and stable coordinates.

options.label: Split-Flap Operations Board
options.lineage: rail concourse boards, departure rhythm, and exception lamps
options.thesis: Orders, signals, feeds, and exceptions are live rows whose state changes are impossible to miss.
options.viewport: One dominant board ranks live signals, orders, fills, sources, and exceptions by event time; fixed columns preserve comprehension while changed characters cascade, and a quieter lower strip carries portfolio and risk context.
options.case: It beats the leader on both axes: operators understand the live board instantly, and fixed columns map cleanly to the real order lifecycle without explanatory UI.
options.risk: Unbounded character animation would become exhausting, so only changed cells flip and reduced-motion mode updates atomically.

options.label: ASCII Event Field
options.lineage: live scenes rendered as selectable character density
options.thesis: Raw and derived state share a living character field whose density exposes signal before the ledger confirms it.
options.viewport: A dominant live event field renders intensity and causal propagation as amber character density while semantic signal, order, and position ledgers remain readable around it.
options.case: Strong quant and systems-programmer identification with a memorable live field; weaker than split-flap for immediate order, allocation, and exception handling.
options.risk: The character field requires a parallel semantic representation, careful contrast, and aggressive density reduction on mobile.

options.label: Strategy Archive Wall
options.lineage: stacked archive boxes and pull-out end labels
options.thesis: Strategies, accounts, and saved workspaces form a physical indexed wall.
options.viewport: A stack of strategy and account records that pulls open for detail.
options.case: The archive is distinctive, but it cannot carry high-rate telemetry or cross-entity order state without fighting its object metaphor.
options.kept: Pull-out detail that preserves the surrounding context remains valuable for inspectors.
options.risk: A browsing metaphor is too slow for incident response.

options.label: Focused Workspace Rails
options.lineage: streaming title walls and focus-expanding horizontal rails
options.thesis: Each operational domain becomes a rail whose focused item expands while the rest recedes.
options.viewport: Horizontal rails for signals, orders, positions, and sources with one expanded item.
options.case: Focus behavior is clear, but hidden metadata and two-axis navigation are hostile to dense comparison and urgent exception work.
options.kept: Focused-row quieting can help a selected causal chain dominate without removing context.
options.risk: It turns an operating system into a content browser.

options.label: Registered Evidence Plates
options.lineage: design annual plate sections and exact registration furniture
options.thesis: Every data surface is a signed evidence plate with exact registration and provenance.
options.viewport: A near-white continuous evidence sheet divided by hairlines and registration marks.
options.case: Exceptionally precise and beautiful, but it conflicts with the dark-default operating scene and lacks the live-state immediacy of the stronger candidates.
options.kept: Registration exactness and signed provenance were donated to the causal field.
options.risk: The product starts reading as a report rather than an always-on operator console.

canonCard.label: Institutional Dark Blotter
canonCard.thesis: The category-standard enterprise OMS, executed with exceptional restraint and clarity.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional collapsible sidebar, portfolio summary, working-order blotter, source health, and alert center.
canonCard.risk: Reliable and immediately legible, but deliberately indistinguishable from polished institutional competitors.
